tests.name: Dielectric strength
tests.description: Dielectric strength test of Clause 8.8.3 for the appropriate type and number of MOP(s) conducted by preparing the sample according to IEC 60851-5:1996, Clause 4.4.1 for a twisted pair

tests.name: Flexibility and adherence
tests.description: Sample subjected to flexibility and adherence test 8 of IEC 60851-3:1996, clause 5.1.1, using mandrel diameters of Table L.1. Followed by dielectric test of clause 8.8.3.

tests.name: Heat Shock
tests.description: Sample subjected to heat shock test 9 of IEC 60851-6:1996, followed by dielectric strength test of clause 8.8.3. Dielectric strength test conducted at room temperature after removal from the oven.

tests.name: Retention of electric strength after bending
tests.description: Five samples prepared as in L.3.2 subjected to dielectric strength and bending tests. Test voltage applied between the shot and conductor.

tests.name: Production line dielectric strength tests
tests.description: Production line dielectric strength tests conducted by the manufacture according to L.4.2 and L.4.3

tests.name: Routine testing (100% testing) dielectric strength
tests.description: Test voltage for routine testing (100% testing)

tests.name: Sampling tests
tests.description: Sampling tests conducted using twisted pair samples (IEC 60851-5:1996, clause 4.4.1). Minimum breakdown test voltage at least twice the voltage in Tables 6 and 7.
